# Naman Chawla

> AI/ML Engineer at Coding Blocks in New Delhi, India. Builds AI products end-to-end on top of large language and generative models: agents, assistants, voice and video AI, and the deployment and GPU infrastructure that runs them in production. Outside of work: research papers and side projects on reinforcement learning, quantization, and distillation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://palindromerice.github.io/): About Naman, with contact and social links
- [Writing](https://palindromerice.github.io/writing/): Published research papers and LinkedIn posts
- [Projects](https://palindromerice.github.io/projects/): Personal ML projects with code

## Projects

- [Single-Bit Quantization of Transformers/BERT](https://github.com/palindromeRice/SingleBitLLMs): Benchmarks single-bit/ternary quantization strategies inspired by BitNet b1.58 on BERT
- [T5 Knowledge Distillation for Summarization](https://github.com/palindromeRice/Knowledge_Distillation_T5): Distills a fine-tuned T5-Base summarizer into T5-Small
- [Mixture-of-Experts Prompt Router](https://github.com/palindromeRice/Moe_demo): Routes prompts to specialized expert models via sentence-embedding similarity
